He is our strength, and he is worthy of our trust.
For he is the way, the truth, and the life.
True, genuine, lasting happiness is found in him and him alone.
Let's pray.
Lord God we do praise you for who you are. We praise you that you are the God who
intimately loves your people. You are the God that dwells among us. May we not lose
sight of that reality. You have given us your very self. And so Lord we find joy
in our life now reflecting on that reality and we also find joy as we look
to the future when all peoples through all times who have proclaimed your name
get to gather before your throne and praise you forevermore. Lord God we
praise you that in you and you alone we can find a joy, a happiness, a blessedness
that is unending. So in your name we pray. Amen.
